description: The DeepSeek official chat is a remote origin (https://chat.deepseek.com), so Tauri's ACL denies its invokes by default. Grant only the pull-string launcher's command so the injected lamp on chat.deepseek.com can raise the management panel over the user's cursor. The URL is intentionally exact (not a `*.deepseek.com` wildcard) so only the chat subdomain — not the marketing site or any future sub-app — can drive IPC.
